B gives no spacing relationship between headings and fields. B covers slightly more alternative scenarios, such as a card around the whole form, but A's spacing guidance and its explanation of clutter are stronger. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers make the same clear recommendation and include a squint test. B covers spacing in more depth: it states the within-versus-between ratio, says headings need about twice as much space above as below, and adds advice on using container gap and toggle tap targets. A gives somewhat more detail on when to switch methods, covering per-section saves, 6 or more sections, and busy page backgrounds.
